__meta: REUSABLE. IVR latency percentiles (RED: Duration). Azure Monitor Logs over AppRequests. ms unit, p50/p95/p99 series, legend table with min/mean/max/p95 calcs — the latency-percentile archetype from the reference dashboard.
title: IVR — Request latency (p50/p95/p99)
description: Request duration percentiles for the IVR app, from App Insights AppRequests.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AppRequests
| where TimeGenerated $__timeFilter()
| summarize P50 = percentile(DurationMs, 50), P95 = percentile(DurationMs, 95), P99 = percentile(DurationMs, 99) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1m)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
